ILLUSTRATED RETURN JOURNEY
01 / RECEIVING

Turn the paperwork into a traveler.

Review delivery and RMA information, identify the product and serial, and assign the item to an owner. A digital traveler gives the return a record you can follow.

OUTPUT: A reviewed receipt and digital traveler

An open exception blocks progression. Inspection and approval requirements must also be completed before an item advances.
